name: The Entrepreneur
source: A young man leaves his college and friends to fulfill his deceased father's dream, to renovate and open the bar he dedicated his life to and therefore, become an Entrepreneur. As he goes back to the city where he was made to the man he is now, he will end up living with three women on which he'll have a major impact. How will he react when facing important choices and what impact on their future will it have ? It is all in your hands.
translation: 为了完成亡父的梦想，一个年轻人告别大学与朋友，打算翻新父亲倾注了一生心血的酒吧，让它重新开张，自己也由此走上创业之路。他回到塑造了今天的自己的那座城市，将与三名女性同住，也将深深影响她们。面对重要的选择，他会如何回应？这又将怎样改变他们的未来？一切尽在你手中。
